_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment (batch S9 UPPAbaby). UPPAbaby CRUZ V2 (2020-2022). Uses CLEK'S OWN adapter for UPPAbaby. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: UPPAbaby CRUZ V2 (2020-2022)

clekListed.clekRow: UPPAbaby CRUZ V2 — **Clek** car seat adapters for UPPAbaby (Clek-made adapter)

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth with infant car seat / bassinet or infant SnugSeat insert; ~3 mo+ in seat

recall.note: No recall covers CRUZ V2 (2020-2022). The 2015 UPPAbaby bumper-bar choking recall was limited to 2015-model-year CRUZ/VISTA/RumbleSeat units.

safety.notes: 5-point no-rethread harness; reversible toddler seat; auto-lock two-hand fold latch.

specs.foldType: two-hand fold with auto-lock, self-standing (folds with seat attached)
specs.recline: multi-position deep recline (near-flat; from-birth needs insert or car seat/bassinet)
specs.tires: foam-filled never-flat wheels; front swivel with lock

notes: CRUZ V2 discontinued/superseded by CRUZ V3; still on a few authorized shelves at $899.99 (Nordstrom shows 'only 1 left') plus resale. ~25.5 lb full-size single, two-hand self-standing fold. Clek Liing attaches via CLEK'S OWN 'Clek car seat adapters for UPPAbaby' (adapter-clek-uppababy). Heavier/bulkier than the city/shopping target.
